verdict.rationale: The only evidence for this story is a single homepage marketing line saying you can 'see which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue' (loops-docs-16). The events API (loops-docs-3) suggests conversion events could be sent in, but nothing shows how attribution actually works. Missing for 10: documentation of how revenue or conversion attribution is calculated, explicit attribution of signups, per-workflow (flow) attribution reporting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
